page.overview:
What is Mega Starmie?

Starmie is a purple starfish-like Pokémon with a red core surrounded by a golden formation. It appears to have more than five appendages.

Interestingly, Starmie's "back-half" has been depicted several different ways. In the anime Starmie has the appearance of two starfish fused together; while in more modern games the back-half has been shown to spin wildly completely independent of the front-half of the Pokémon. Many fans tend to think of the anime's depiction as the more realistic of the two, considering the rapid spinning would obviously get in the way of any trainer trying to surf on this particular Pokémon. Starmie's core shines in a rainbow of seven colors, some people value this core as a type of jewelry.

Upon Mega Evolution, Starmie’s bottom appendages elongate in size to become legs, allowing it to take on a human-like form and behaviors. The edges of its golden formation are also somewhat altered as well.

They can flash their gems in a single color, alternating between different shades as if sending coded messages. Starmie swim by spinning themselves like propellers through the water, filter-feeding as they go.
